title: DeepGram
tagline: DeepGram makes it possible for everyday people to interact with DeFi
description: DeepGram makes it possible for everyday people to interact with DeFi by borrowing familiar social media habits. It delivers margin trading, spot trading, and copy trading through an Instagram-Reels-style feed where users learn about projects and act by swiping, scrolling, or cop trading. This reduces defi's usual onboarding friction and increases engagement, and channels new activity into the Sui ecosystem, delivering more traders, more liquidity, more discovery for builders, and more reasons to stay on chain
how_its_made: We built DeepGram as a Sui‑native web app with Next.js Mysten’s dapp‑kit for wallet auth and transaction signing. Trades route through DeepBook for spot and margin, and we use dev‑inspect calls to price, size, and validate orders before submission we aggressively simulate swaps to auto‑fill quotes and enforce minimums, then submit a single transaction for fast UX
